kind: Hosted isolated Chromium; synthetic sketch; one real image cast; cloud backup mocked unavailable to keep fixture out of the owner archive

localShare.text: I drew it, muttered “A small stone wizard cottage, with a steep triangular roof. Keep the position and proportions of my sketch. Render the walls, roof tiles and a small wooden door in ink and gentle watercolor.”, and the parchment got carried away.
localShare.title: A small act of sorcery
